newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans found guilty of attack on black Britons.
newsitem.headline: Germans found guilty of attack on black Britons.

text.p: A court on Monday sentenced two young German men to jail for an attack on three black Britons last June which left one of the victims paralysed from the neck down.

The court in Potsdam near Berlin sentenced Mario Poetter, 24, and Sandro Ristau, 18, to eight years and five years respectively for reckless driving and causing grievous bodily harm in a high-speed car chase which led to the Britons' car overturning.

Noel Martin, 36, from Birmingham, was paralysed when the car the Britons were in crashed into a tree in the village of Mahlow, south of Berlin, after the Germans threw a rock through their rear window.
Poetter and Ristau admitted to shouting "nigger" at the British construction workers at a train station before pursuing them, and then hurling a rock through the window.
They claimed the crash occurred when the three Britons attempted to chase after them after they had thrown the rock.
Poetter and Ristau told police that they mixed with local neo-Nazi circles in Mahlow but denied belonging to any organised racist group.
